en.text:
I am a Full-Stack Developer with 2.7+ years of experience building modern, responsive, and scalable web applications using the MERN stack. I enjoy creating intuitive user experiences with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern UI practices, while also working across backend development with Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, and MongoDB.

Throughout my experience, I’ve worked on real-world products, collaborated with cross-functional teams, and taken ownership of features from development to deployment. I’m passionate about building clean, efficient, and user-focused solutions that solve real business problems.

Currently, I’m expanding my expertise into Generative AI and AI application development. I’m actively learning LLMs, prompt engineering, AI APIs, and AI-powered application architecture while building AARA, an independent AI wellness companion as a hands-on project. I believe the best way to learn emerging technology is by building with it, and I’m excited to combine my full-stack engineering experience with AI to create practical, intelligent, and meaningful products.

es.text:
Soy un desarrollador de {{PHP}} con [[más de una década]] de experiencia, especializado en desarrollo backend y con algo de experiencia en frontend. También tengo experiencia práctica en entornos de producción con C++, C#, Go y Python.

Este variado historial me permite adaptarme a una amplia gama de necesidades de proyectos, ya sea construyendo APIs escalables, optimizando el rendimiento de sistemas o contribuyendo a soluciones full-stack.

¡Espero con interés colaborar [[contigo!]]

저는 {{백엔드}} 개발을 전문으로 하고, 프론트엔드 작업도 일부 수행해온 [[10년 이상의]] 경력을 가진 PHP 개발자입니다. 또한 C++, C#, Go, Python 스택을 사용한 프로덕션 경험도 있습니다.

이 다양한 배경 덕분에 프로젝트의 다양한 요구에 유연하게 대처할 수 있습니다. 확장 가능한 API 구축, 시스템 성능 최적화, 또는 전체 스택 솔루션에 기여하는 등 다양한 분야에 능숙하게 참여할 수 있습니다. 저는 각 프로젝트에 맞는 최적의 도구를 찾는 것과 새로운 도전을 즐깁니다.

[[당신과 협업]]하기를 기대하고 있습니다!

en.title: CEO, Wheeliyo
en.text: Sansheya has been an incredible contributor to our product development journey. She has worked across both frontend and backend, taking ownership of features from building responsive React interfaces to developing and integrating REST APIs. Her ability to understand product requirements, solve problems independently, and turn ideas into reliable features has made a strong impact on the Wheeliyo platform.

en.title: Engineering Manager, Zeitview
en.text: I had the pleasure of working with Sansheya at Zeitview. She is a highly motivated developer who quickly takes ownership of challenging tasks and consistently looks for opportunities to learn and improve. She contributed to complex frontend features such as image visualization, anomaly detection, and dynamic data interfaces while also working with backend APIs. Her adaptability, problem-solving skills, and commitment to delivering quality work made her a valuable member of the team.

en.title: Engineering Manager, Kissflow
en.text: Sansheya was a dedicated and dependable developer who consistently approached her work with curiosity and attention to detail. She worked on customer-facing features with a strong focus on responsive design, usability, accessibility, and clean implementation. She collaborated well with the team, quickly understood requirements, and was always willing to take on new challenges and improve her technical skills.

en.title: Client, BalaKrishna IAS
en.text: Working with Sansheya on our chatbot project was a great experience. She understood our requirements well and transformed the idea into an intuitive and engaging application. Her ability to work across the frontend and backend, integrate APIs, and focus on the overall user experience helped bring the project together smoothly. She was responsive to feedback, proactive in solving issues, and committed to delivering a solution that met our expectations.
